description: Holds every futures market (equity indexes, bonds, energy, metals, grains, currencies) whose 12-month return is positive, equally weighted, rebalanced monthly. Time-series momentum, the core of managed-futures trend following. Backtested on FinzData futures: each market is its front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar, as an excess-return index (no interest on collateral), 5 bps costs per trade, re-run free on full history.
title: Futures trend · 12-month time-series momentum · 26 markets (after Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen 2012)
